newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKMA injects HK$107 mln into interbank market.
newsitem.headline: HKMA injects HK$107 mln into interbank market.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said it injected HK$107 million into the interbank market on Friday morning in view of the tight liquidity of the Hong Kong dollar.
"The liquidity is tight," HKMA spokesman Albert Chan said by telephone.
On Thursday, the territory's defacto central bank injected about HK$128 million into the market.
A number of initial public offerings are being launched in the territory and analysts say they can increase the demand for Hong Kong dollars. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6590
